title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Payments Standard: Which Authorization Drafts a Due Date When a New One Is Verified
content:
**Standard.** Only one Bluegate AutoPay Authorization drafts an agreement for a given due date. When a new authorization is verified before the cutoff of the next due date, that due date is drafted by the new authorization and the old one is retired. When the new authorization is verified after the cutoff, the old authorization still drafts that due date and is retired the day after. A due date is never drafted by two authorizations. Each attempt number on a due date is used once.

**Record meaning.** An authorization retired this way shows the status *replaced*, with its end reason recorded as replaced by a new method and the retirement date as its end date. An authorization may be retired from active or from suspended status.

**Attempt numbers.** On one agreement and one due date, attempt 1 is the first draft and attempts 2 and up are retries or re-presentments; a given attempt number on that agreement and due date appears once, so a further attempt on the same due date carries a number not yet used.

## Decision table

| New authorization verified | Who drafts the next due date | When the old authorization is retired |
|---|---|---|
| Before the cutoff of the next due date | The new authorization | On verification of the new one |
| After the cutoff of the next due date | The old authorization | The day after that due date's draft |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

1. Next due date the 20th; the new authorization is verified before that due date's cutoff. The new authorization drafts the 20th, and the old one is retired.
2. Next due date the 20th; the new authorization is verified after that due date's cutoff. The old authorization drafts the 20th and is retired the day after.
3. In either case, the due date of the 20th shows a draft from one authorization only.
